description: Machine-readable evidence manifest for CogniShift Phase 6 Windows Firewall & OS-Level Observer Reality Check
notice: Cryptographic SHA-256 hashes provide integrity verification after creation. They do not prove evidence truthfulness at creation time.

firewall_after.txt.purpose: Verification of clean firewall teardown restoring baseline rule count with 0 orphaned rules

firewall_before.txt.purpose: Baseline Windows Defender Firewall rule count and state before CogniShift rules enabled

firewall_enabled.txt.purpose: Inspected active CogniShift firewall rules, address filters, and application filters

firewall_loopback_test.json.purpose: Empirical raw socket connection to loopback service (127.0.0.1:11434) with rules active

firewall_private_test.json.purpose: Empirical raw socket connection to unauthorized private LAN IP (192.168.1.254:80) blocked by OS firewall

firewall_public_control_test.json.purpose: Empirical control socket to 1.1.1.1:80 with firewall disabled proving causality (connected=True)

firewall_public_test.json.purpose: Empirical raw socket connection to public IP (1.1.1.1:80) blocked by OS firewall (WinError 10013)

HUMAN_RECHECK.md.purpose: Independent human operator verification guide with step-by-step reproduction instructions

observer_vs_application_ledger.json.purpose: Cross-correlation analysis between OS network observer connections and SQLite network_events audit ledger

os_observer_negative_control.json.purpose: Negative control socket connection executed while PktMon kernel packet monitor is recording

os_observer_setup.txt.purpose: Windows PktMon independent kernel packet capture configuration and capture timestamps
os_observer_setup.txt.generating_command: pktmon filter add -p 11434; pktmon start --capture -f os_trace.etl

os_observer_strict_workflow.json.purpose: Full representative workflow execution report under independent observer (0 unauthorized connections)

os_trace.etl.purpose: Raw binary Windows Event Trace Log (ETW) from PktMon driver capturing kernel packet events

os_trace.txt.purpose: Decoded human-readable text dump of kernel packet events confirming loopback packet drops/flows

os_trace_sample_utf8.txt.purpose: UTF-8 sample snippet of decoded PktMon trace lines showing packet flow on 127.0.0.1:11434
